body_html:
I try to avoid starting the digital #literacies conversation from a place of plagiarism. As an educator assume the best in children. Plagiarism mistakes often made out of lack of knowledge about summarizing rather than malice.

When you trace things like #digcit (digital citizenship) you will see we always approached digital education like the web was this big bad scary things and all out kids would do is steal mp3s...Literally, digital citizenship began around copyright.

This pitched the web as lesser than.
